decisions.intent: Show a reference warning before document, notebook, Outline and editor deletion can remove a referenced block definition.

preconditions: A user initiates a document, notebook, heading or block deletion that can remove a definition block.
The active Kernel exposes the checked block-reference API.
stateTransitions: The owner queries the removal set before its irreversible request or DOM transaction.
A positive result adds the localized reference warning to the existing confirmation flow.
outputs: Unreferenced document removal preserves the existing no-confirm configuration behavior.
Referenced removal presents a warning and leaves the final confirmation under user control.
invariants: A failed reference query leaves the target untouched.
The local desktop, mobile and gutter owners use their existing transactions rather than reviving upstream monolithic UI code.
failures: Kernel errors are surfaced by the shared reference-check message path and stop removal.

testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest --run test/protyle/crossBlockEditing.test.ts test/protyle/cutClipboard.transaction.test.ts test/protyle/removeFoundation.test.ts test/protyle/listItemActions.test.ts test/layout/dock/outline/Outline.helpers.test.ts

decisions.intent: Correct reference-check regressions by checking the actual deletion set and restoring active observers when asynchronous confirmation does not proceed.

preconditions: A deletion path resolves a heading, list, super-block or editor removal transaction.
The target may change while a confirmation dialog is open.
stateTransitions: The exact block IDs belonging to a removal transaction are checked before DOM mutation.
A declined, failed or stale confirmation ends the operation and restores the observer when it had been disconnected.
outputs: The current DOM is modified only after confirmation and connectivity checks succeed.
Folded heading deletion uses the same resolved transaction for reference checking and mutation.
invariants: No async confirmation result is applied to a detached target.
Container references use exact IDs only when the container itself is removed.
failures: Missing operation data or block IDs are logged and terminate deletion without a partial transaction.

notes: The local code separates reusable reference confirmation from list and block mutation owners.

decisions.intent: Warn before cutting a cross-block selection that fully removes referenced definitions.

preconditions: The editor has a cross-block range or an image selection to cut.
The selected content can fully remove one or more definition blocks.
stateTransitions: The editor projects the selection to actual removable blocks and exact definition IDs.
The reference prompt and clipboard write complete before any DOM or transaction mutation.
outputs: A declined prompt or rejected clipboard write preserves the original selection content.
A successful cut keeps existing rich clipboard formats and removes only the confirmed blocks.
invariants: Partial selection of a block does not mark that block as an exact definition deletion.
Nested list and retained end-block content are not over-reported as deleted definitions.
failures: Clipboard rejection is reported and prevents the cut transaction.

notes: Local Range and clipboard helpers remain separate because rich native bridge formats and browser Clipboard API acknowledgement have different semantics.

decisions.intent: Finalize the referenced cut and deletion flow for range, image, folded-heading and cross-block mutations.

preconditions: The user invokes Delete, Backspace or Cut from a Protyle editor surface.
The action may resolve to a cross-block merge, final image deletion or folded heading transaction.
stateTransitions: Each action derives reference-check targets before changing DOM state.
The operation rechecks connectivity after asynchronous confirmation and writes clipboard data before a cut mutation.
outputs: Referenced content gets a single confirmation path across keyboard, dock, mobile and gutter entry points.
Undo focus, list ordering and existing transaction operations remain preserved after a successful cross-block deletion.
invariants: No confirmation, API or clipboard failure silently proceeds with deletion.
All transaction operation IDs are validated before cross-block DOM mutation.
failures: Missing parent IDs, operation data or detached elements produce explicit errors and stop the operation.

testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest --run test/protyle/crossBlockEditing.test.ts test/protyle/cutClipboard.transaction.test.ts test/protyle/removeFoundation.test.ts test/protyle/listItemActions.test.ts test/layout/dock/outline/Outline.helpers.test.ts
